messages:
Sam (Finance): Received invoice VV-2107 for $6,320. No PO on PDF; AP placed hold. PDF here: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/VV-2107.pdf
Priya (Procurement): Opening PO registry... do we have any open POs for Vertex?
Jordan (Eng): We have BLT-210 (blanket) and CO-3 was issued for a last-month spike. Vendor should reference BLT-210/CO-3.
Priya (Procurement): I see BLT-210 active. CO-3 exists and was for dev hours in Jan. Amount on invoice is similar to CO-3 but invoice references PO-0217 (typo?).
VertexVendor AP: Sorry, our team mistyped the PO number. Correct PO is BLT-210/CO-3. Re-uploading corrected invoice VV-2107-v2.pdf now.
Sam (Finance): AP needs either PO on invoice or approver note. Can Eng or cost owner approve charge to BLT-210?
Jordan (Eng): I approve charging BLT-210/CO-3 for VV-2107. Tagging Priya for procurement memo.
Priya (Procurement): Adding procurement note: "Match to BLT-210/CO-3 confirmed; split GL 4200 (100%). Approver: Jordan." Attaching memo.
ap_bot: Invoice VV-2107 updated, procurement memo attached, routing to AP queue #4489.
Sam (Finance): Match OK, releasing hold. Scheduling payment next run. :white_check_mark:
VertexVendor AP: Thanks, confirming payment expected on next cycle.
Priya (Procurement): Adding audit comment to BLT-210. Closing thread.
